subject.title: Slack Socket Mode events not reaching Gateway despite full config per documentation

question: Should maintainers keep this as a broad Slack Socket Mode delivery report until the missing local diagnostics are posted, or route it to the reaction-specific issue now?
rationale: The public issue lacks the attached report, and the related reaction issue is plausible but not proven to cover the same event family or root cause.

options.title: Keep Broad Pending Diagnostics
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for redacted `openclaw channels status --probe --json`, gateway trace logs, and the raw Socket Mode event family before changing code or closing as a duplicate.

options.title: Route To Reaction Report
options.body: If the missing report is confirmed to be reaction-only, treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/56653 as the canonical issue and preserve this thread as supporting context.

options.title: Close Later As Insufficient
options.body: If no diagnostics arrive after the stale-info window and current main still cannot reproduce the symptom, close with a request for a new issue containing logs and config details.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Pending Diagnostics
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and ask for redacted `openclaw channels status --probe --json`, gateway trace logs, and the raw Socket Mode event family before changing code or closing as a duplicate.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is on the Slack Socket Mode filter and recent diagnostics boundary that controls duplicate routing and proof expectations.
